svg.title: Model editing evaluation: teacher forcing versus autoregressive decoding
svg.desc: Original paper artwork animated in paired steps. Both models first predict Beyoncé. Synthetic evaluation then supplies BC from the reference answer; WILD feeds back its own Beyoncé. After five steps, synthetic evaluation compares positions, giving cross, check, cross, check, check and three out of five. WILD stops at EOS and judges the entire answer incorrect, score zero.
